description: This file contains React hooks and a utility function to facilitate progressive batch processing within a React application, specifically for expanding tree nodes or similar batch operations without blocking the UI. It defines and exports createProgressiveExpandController, a non-React utility for batching work using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, and useProgressiveExpand, a React hook managing UI state and controlling the batching process.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, utilizing requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, with support for progress updates, cancellation, and completion callbacks.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the createProgressiveExpandController, managing UI state such as running status and progress, and provides functions to start processing from a list of items or cancel ongoing processing.
